notes.title: June 17th Update
notes.notes:
- Puzls are now easier to buy and less expensive! Each puzl costs one Puzl Credit. Puzl Credits cost $1 each, 5 for $3.99 or 20 for $14.99.
- Added the ability to raise hand in workshops and Happy Hour puzls.

notes.title: May 3rd Update
notes.notes:
- New "Select" button lets you draw a box around pieces to select them.
- Move selected pieces as a group, or sort only the selected pieces.

notes.title: 4/24/21 Update: Smoother framerate, and fixed crash
notes.notes:
Today's update focuses on optimizations and bug fixes. The framerate will now be higher, especially on older machines, resulting in smoother animation. A major memory leak has been fixed, which should prevent crashes. 

Also, in a multiplayer puzl you can now click on the name of another player to show a menu. From that menu you can add the player to your friends list, or mute them.
